BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to manufacturer liability; and adding a new sectionto chapter 7.72 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A manufacturer of goods is not liable for harm caused by defects ingoods attributed to such a manufacturer where the goods have beenpurchased through a chain of distribution that does not establish themanufacturer as the lawful source of the defective product. Thissection does not apply where the harm is caused by: (1) Willful or wanton acts of negligence by the manufacturer; (2) Conscious indifference or reckless disregard for the safety ofothers by the manufacturer; or (3) Intentional conduct on the part of the manufacturer.
